name: DTAN Server
description: DTAN Server is a specialized nostr relay for NIP-35 torrents. It combines a Nostr relay with DHT-based peer discovery to enable decentralized torrent distribution through the Nostr network. The server acts as both a Nostr relay for torrent metadata and a tracker for peer discovery using DHT. It includes a web UI built with DTAN for managing torrents and monitoring the relay.
author: v0l
